summary: Marketing is in high gear with Asia Star and Intelligent China as top priorities, while the China Going-Global report and Tech In Asia sponsorship demand urgent attention this week.
summaryDetail: The team is prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China for SEO and marketing, with a focus on AI, EV, and smart manufacturing content, and is analyzing participant data to refine target audiences. The website redesign is moving forward, incorporating Joseph's design elements to surface more articles and indices on the homepage, with feedback due soon. This week, urgent items include finalizing the Tech In Asia sponsorship details (event brief, confirmation email) and the Caixin Singapore summit collaboration decision, while Joseph must review the China Going-Global report and provide a Manaferra summary. Upcoming, the team will execute the SEO strategy, launch the redesigned website, and prepare for the Tech In Asia side event in September.
